name: romm
title: RomM
description: RomM is a ROM manager and web player for your retro game library: scans the folder per platform, fetches covers and metadata (IGDB or ScreenScraper credentials optional), and plays many systems in the browser through EmulatorJS. Put ROMs under <library>/roms/<platform>/, create the admin account on the first visit.

variables.name: ROMM_IGDB_CLIENT_ID
variables.label: IGDB client ID
variables.description: Optional: a Twitch developer app (https://api-docs.igdb.com) for covers and metadata

variables.name: ROMM_IGDB_CLIENT_TOKEN
variables.label: IGDB client secret
variables.description: The client secret of that app

variables.name: ROMM_AUTH_SECRET_KEY
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: ROMM_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: ROMM_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database root password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy
